target_customer: E-commerce sellers and brands in Latin America that pay for pickup, fulfillment and same day or next day delivery
problem: E-commerce sellers in Latin America lacked fast, reliable and affordable logistics; clicOH provides an asset light network for storing, packing and shipping orders.
business_model: Logistics services priced per shipment and fulfillment, built on an asset light network of independent drivers and pickup points
product_category: E-commerce logistics and last mile delivery

founders.name: Agustin Novillo Saravia
founders.background_notes: Role per Cronista as reported in search results; YC page gives no bio.

founders.name: Juan Martin Altamirano
founders.background_notes: Born and raised in Cordoba, Argentina per YC page.

founders.name: Emiliano Segura
founders.background_notes: Role per press as reported in search results; YC page gives only a quote.

technical_complexity.rationale: Routing, tracking and platform integrations (Shopify, Tienda Nube, Mercado Libre) are standard engineering; the hard part is operating a physical network.

defensibility.rationale: Network of pickup points and warehousing plus integrations with e-commerce platforms; asset light model is copyable but scale in three countries takes time.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No sourced case of copying or acquisition; clicOH itself acquired Rayo in Chile and LOGYSTO in Colombia (2022).

market_need_then: E-commerce grew quickly in Latin America during COVID-19 and sellers needed reliable delivery; clicOH shifted from a delivery app to e-commerce logistics in 2019 and entered YC in 2021.

identity.voice_and_tone: Amazon-like logistics positioning; partner language for drivers (aliados)

branding.community_and_virality: Recruits independent drivers as aliados; regional press coverage in Argentina and Chile.

brand_strength.rationale: Regional business press covers the company, but no source discusses the brand itself and the name origin is unknown.

pivots.why: Reported by search results as a shift in 2019; the reason is not stated

outcome_analysis: clicOH pivoted from a delivery app to e-commerce logistics in 2019, joined YC in Winter 2021, raised a 25 million dollar Series A led by Tiger Global in May 2022 and expanded through acquisitions into Colombia and Chile. It listed about 155 people in YC data and operates in Mexico, Colombia and Argentina. Fast e-commerce growth and execution drove the rise, while the capital intensity of logistics is the main risk.
notes: Series A reported by Business Wire, FinSMEs and others (Business Wire page fetch got 403; details from search result text). Total funding of about 33M is a search snippet claim; a reported 3M after YC in June 2021 appears only in one outlet and an unverified 5M Peru investment is not a round, so neither is recorded. An aggregator date of February 2025 conflicts and is ignored. Founding year 2018 per La Nacion via search, 2019 per YC.
